title: How Does a 400-Ton Plane Fly? ✈️
description: Wings don't fly by magic... they push air down and the air pushes them up! Plus, discover the famous myth taught in schools.

scenes.text: Four hundred tons in the sky!
scenes.say: A massive plane weighing over four hundred tons floats in the sky like a feather. What is the secret?

scenes.caption: The angled wing
scenes.say: The secret is the wing. Its curved shape and slight tilt push huge amounts of air downward.
According to Newton's third law, every action has a reaction. The air pushed down forces the wing up, creating lift.

right.label: Myth
right.sub: Air on top meets air below

scenes.say: A famous myth says air over the wing speeds up to meet the air below. The truth is it's much faster and they never meet.

scenes.label: Cruising speed
scenes.say: More speed means more lift. That is why commercial airplanes cruise at nearly nine hundred kilometers per hour.
